fusions.name: Plaster Cast
fusions.desc: Throws a plaster strip that wraps the first enemy it meets, which deals 11 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Hindered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Chalk Snap
fusions.desc: Snaps a chalked cord at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Marked] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Under One Tarpaulin
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Linen Gambeson
fusions.desc: Conjures a linen coat: every hit you take deals 1 less damage, your armour rises by 6%, and your dodge chance rises by 5%.
